Core Engine

The Vectoris Engine

A purpose-built ANN retrieval core designed for sub-millisecond query latency at billion-vector scale. Every component — from graph construction to quantization codecs — is optimized for production AI workloads.

HNSW Graph Index

Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs with configurable efConstruction and M parameters. Achieve 95%+ recall at p99 latency under 5ms on 100M+ vector corpora.

  • ✓ Layer-wise greedy search with early termination
  • ✓ Dynamic edge pruning for memory efficiency
  • ✓ Parallel graph construction across shards

IVF-PQ Quantization

Inverted file indexes with product quantization reduce memory footprint by up to 90%. Ideal for cold-tier storage and cost-optimized retrieval tiers.

  • ✓ Adaptive centroid clustering (k-means++)
  • ✓ PQ-8 through PQ-64 codec selection
  • ✓ SIMD-accelerated distance computation

Hybrid Retrieval Pipeline

Fuse sparse BM25 scores with dense cosine similarity in a single query path. Configurable fusion weights and cross-encoder reranking stages.

  • ✓ Reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) scoring
  • ✓ Two-stage retrieve-then-rerank architecture
  • ✓ Filtered ANN with metadata predicates

Live Index Mutation

Add, update, and delete vectors without downtime. Segment-based architecture enables hot-swapping index shards during live traffic.

  • ✓ WAL-backed incremental updates
  • ✓ Background compaction and merge
  • ✓ Versioned snapshot checkpoints
